name: speech-mcp
description: SOTA-grade MCP server for multi-provider voice orchestration (Hume AI + ElevenLabs + Windows TTS) with RAG knowledge base.
author: Sandra Schipal

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Synthesize speech and play it on the PC speaker. Providers: windows (SAPI5, no key), hume, gemini, gemma (local), elevenlabs.

tools.name: text_to_dialogue
tools.description: Multi-voice dialogue synthesis via ElevenLabs, played on the PC speaker.

tools.name: transcribe_audio_file
tools.description: Transcribe a local audio file with speaker labels, timestamps, and punctuation. FunASR default, Gemini/Gemma optional.

tools.name: transcribe_stream_chunk
tools.description: Stateless transcription of a single audio fragment from a stream bridge.

tools.name: start_evi_session
tools.description: Initialize a real-time Empathic Voice Interface (Hume EVI) WebSocket session.

tools.name: manage_domestic_utility
tools.description: Domestic utility gateway: set/cancel/query timers, query weather, schedule alarms.

tools.name: trigger_action
tools.description: Declared IoT bridge stub: light_on/light_off/notify return pending_orchestration with next steps (no fake success).

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Semantic RAG search over the speech-mcp knowledge base (LanceDB + FastEmbed).

tools.name: ask_docs
tools.description: Ask complex questions about speech AI. Uses RAG retrieval + LLM sampling (ctx.sample) for grounded answers.

tools.name: manage_voice_clones
tools.description: Lifecycle management for voice clones (list, create, delete) across supported providers.

tools.name: configure_local_wake_word
tools.description: Start or stop the offline openWakeWord listener.

tools.name: detect_wake_word
tools.description: Arm Gemini Multimodal Live VAD for voice activity detection.

tools.name: run_speech_demo
tools.description: Execute a hardware-specific speech or capability demo script.

tools.name: play_audio_file
tools.description: Diagnostic tool: play an arbitrary audio file on the system speaker.

tools.name: agentic_conversation_workflow
tools.description: SEP-1577 autonomous conversation mission via ctx.sample + ctx.elicit.

tools.name: orchestrate_alexa_pattern
tools.description: Alexa-style proactive mission orchestration with adaptive responding.

tools.name: safety_validate_intent
tools.description: Validate speech text against social engineering patterns.

tools.name: safety_verify_auth
tools.description: Verify a Speech-MCP auth token against SPEECH_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN.

tools.name: safety_log_audit
tools.description: Log a permanent audit trail for high-intensity emotional speech.

tools.name: prosody_dashboard
tools.description: Real-time prosody and emotional status dashboard (Prefab card).

tools.name: speech_activity_chart
tools.description: Speech activity bar chart showing token usage across recent sessions (Prefab card).

tools.name: fleet_health_overview
tools.description: Comprehensive fleet health overview for all speech providers (Prefab card).

tools.name: provider_capability_matrix
tools.description: Provider function matrix showing support for advanced speech features (Prefab card).

tools.name: latency_benchmark_view
tools.description: Comparative latency (TTFB) metrics for high-fidelity speech engines (Prefab card).
